name: M5.PhysicalRecovery.decode_encode
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (A B : Finset ℕ), 0 < N → A ⊆ Finset.range N → B ⊆ Finset.range N → 0 ∈ A → 0 ∈ B → (M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedA N (M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode N A B) = A ∧ M5.PhysicalRecovery.selectedB N (M5.PhysicalRecovery.encode N A B) = B)
guidance: Finset extensionality. Zero is already anchored; each positive position s<N corresponds uniquely to i=s-1 in range(N-1). List.getElem?_ofFn identifies encoded membership. Cases at the offset distinguish the two blocks. No weight, signature or injectivity assumption may be added. Return tactic lines only, without leading by.
